limitations: This is an offline authored contact QA sequence, not an interruptible live controller
Root/COG and limb actuation are kinematic; whole-body dynamic balance is not solved
The object-specific grasp uses an explicit compliant spring joint, not verified friction-only force closure or arbitrary-object grasp
Contact distances sample collision proxy surfaces; native Bullet contact impulses are not exposed by this report
Hair follows the head; no independent hair physics was added
Native cloth was evaluated sequentially; visual contact/cloth stability still requires review
Art has not been certified against the video reference
